items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: That happened to be where I met my first wife, Emma, who is the mother of my oldest daughter, Sylvia.

ctx.x: Yeah. Sebastian was still the owner of it. And he had some wild shows in there, you know. They had all the prettiest chorus girls they could find -- all stacked, of course. [LAUGHS] That happened to be where I met my first wife, Emma, who is the mother of my oldest daughter, Sylvia.
Well, on this earlier occasion you referred to Toni as your first wife.
